name: ai4s-skills
description: AI4Science end-to-end research pipeline: topic exploration → literature survey → experiment execution → paper writing. Forked from ai4s-research/ai4s-skills.

plugins.name: ai4s-skills
plugins.description: Installs the full AI4Science toolkit. Registers all 7 skills under the ai4s-skills namespace, callable as /ai4s-skills:paper-writer, /ai4s-skills:research-explorer, etc.

plugins.name: ai4s-skills-paper-writer
plugins.description: End-to-end research paper builder. Generates complete LaTeX papers with 200+ real bibliography entries, publication-grade figures, and quality gates.

plugins.name: ai4s-skills-research-explorer
plugins.description: Research direction and topic exploration for AI4Science workflows.

plugins.name: ai4s-skills-literature-survey
plugins.description: Literature survey and bibliography building for AI4Science workflows.

plugins.name: ai4s-skills-experiment-suite
plugins.description: Experiment execution and results generation for AI4Science workflows.

plugins.name: ai4s-skills-ai4s-agent
plugins.description: Master orchestrator that coordinates the full AI4Science pipeline: research-explorer → literature-survey → experiment-suite → paper-writer.

plugins.name: ai4s-skills-mindmap-render
plugins.description: Mind map rendering for research visualization.
